title: About Me
intro:
Over a decade in data science, turning complex data into scalable analytics products and actionable business insights. I work across analytical strategy, workflow automation, AI-enabled solutions, and cross-functional delivery—from methodology and modeling to dashboards and market intelligence.

Beyond work, boxing sharpens my discipline and resilience, while coding transforms ideas into working products. Together with AI, they help me explore, build, and create with purpose.
